name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Spread Ample
scope: Finite hypercubes and finite binary classes.
statement: Every finite hypercube is spread ample, and the containment is strict.
proof: Every pc-minor of a cube is a cube, whose antipodal vertices realize the full active-coordinate diameter. The vertex-deleted cube $Q_3^-$ is spread ample but is not a hypercube.
